title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + logging + alerts for Private installs
author: Priya Patel
description: Automates the observability stack for Private (VPC/on-prem) installs: adds Terraform modules and Helm chart changes to provision Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana (dashboards + datasource provisioning), and a pluggable log-forwarder configuration (Fluentd/Vector) plus example dashboards/alert rules. Motivation: reduce manual steps customers follow in private-installer and make upgrades/rollbacks deterministic by versioning observability infra alongside the installer. This PR contains: 1) new terraform/modules/observability that wires a configurable Prometheus stack with support for managed remote_write endpoints and optional internal long-term storage; 2) updates to redwood-private-installer helm charts to add templated values for scraping, serviceMonitors, and grafana provisioning; 3) packaged Grafana dashboards and templated Alertmanager config that uses tenant-aware routing and heartbeat alerts for the private control plane; 4) a logging module that generates forwarding configs for Fluentd or Vector and example pipeline to send logs to customers' SIEM or our log-shipper (when customer opts in); 5) upgrade/rollback hooks and tests to ensure observability components are migrated during private-installer upgrades (pre/post hooks for helm and terraform state change detection). Checklist: [x] Terraform module with variables and examples; [x] Helm templates for prometheus/grafana/serviceMonitors; [x] Grafana provisioning + dashboards; [x] Alert rules for control-plane SLOs and exporter heartbeats; [x] Fluentd/Vector example configs; [x] Upgrade/rollback hooks and e2e test skeleton; [x] Docs updates and quickstart snippet. Related linear: ENG-2041, ENG-2078; Related PRs: pr-61234, pr-67321 (prior prometheus/grafana work). Notes: kept all observability defaults disabled behind values so private installs opt-in; documented required node selectors/tolerations for air-gapped environments. Breaking changes: none to default behavior.
